description: A function created with `useEffectEvent` that reads the latest props and state but is not reactive.
React 19.2 Hook: `const onEvent = useEffectEvent(callback)`. Call the result only from inside effects.
A callback that captured an old value because the effect that created it did not re-run.
Values that decide *when* to re-synchronize go in dependencies; values only *read* when something happens belong in Effect Events.
